<quote by="Proposed: Miaren, Seconded: Conscience of the Senate">To build Stones from Blood, a mana ministry for the Navarr vates council. This is to support the Navarr vates in organisation and in providing mana for national rituals such as Dance of Navarr and Thorn. It is expected the holder will take an oath.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a ministry in [[Therunin]] for the purchase of mana crystals 
* Passed
==Date==

==Cost==

* 12 wains of mithril
* 36 crowns
* Three months to complete
